excerpt.zh: 这颗潮汐锁定的行星似乎具有各种宜居行星的建筑模块。也许在上面能建造一些东西。
excerpt.en: This tidally locked planet appears to have all the building blocks for a habitable world. Perhaps there is something that can be built here.
